title: MIGHTY Power Adapter
description:
The Mighty Power Adapter is a reliable, lightweight and durable DC plug that safely charges your Mighty batteries. It is designed and manufactured by Storz & Bickel, the producers of the Mighty Vaporizer. This power adapter is the perfect replacement or spare if you have misplaced the original adapter or if it is no longer functioning properly.

This robust 110-volt Adapter quickly recharges the Mighty’s dual Lithium Ion batteries. Attaching the power adapter to the vaporizer and plugging it in will charge the unit in just two hours. Don’t miss out on your vaping sessions due to low battery life! Get the Mighty Power Adapter today and keep your device running smoothly.
